ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Oct-09-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: his cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change and Gender Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry Dorfman, Clerk: S.Vantree, Court Reporter: Mitch Lyon, CSR #6840
Petitioner ROBERT EARL CATER present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examined.
Declaration of Sworn Physician on file.

No objections to the proposed change of name and gender were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations of the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Name Change to ROBYN D'VYN THOMPSON and Gender from male to female.
Decree changing Name and Gender signed by the court.
